requirements.statement: Permanent registrations for values between 0x00 and 0x3f inclusive MUST be assigned using Standards Action or IESG Approval as defined in Sections 4.9 and 4.10 of RFC8126.

requirements.title: Assign specification-required permanent registrations above 0x3f
requirements.statement: Permanent registrations for values larger than 0x3f MUST be assigned using the Specification Required policy as defined in RFC8126.

requirements.title: Require Expert Review for provisional registrations above 0x3f
requirements.statement: Provisional registrations for values larger than 0x3f MUST require Expert Review, as defined in Section 4.5 of RFC8126.

requirements.title: Specification optional for provisional registrations
requirements.statement: The Specification field MAY be omitted for provisional registrations.

requirements.title: Allow summary descriptions when a specification reference exists
requirements.statement: The Description field MAY be a summary if a Specification reference is provided.

requirements.title: Allow date updates on provisional registrations without expert review
requirements.statement: A request to update the Date on any provisional registration MAY be made without review from the designated expert(s).

requirements.title: Assign 0x0 to DOQ_NO_ERROR
requirements.statement: The value 0x0 MUST be assigned to DOQ_NO_ERROR.

requirements.title: Assign 0x1 to DOQ_INTERNAL_ERROR
requirements.statement: The value 0x1 MUST be assigned to DOQ_INTERNAL_ERROR.

requirements.title: Assign 0x2 to DOQ_PROTOCOL_ERROR
requirements.statement: The value 0x2 MUST be assigned to DOQ_PROTOCOL_ERROR.

requirements.title: Assign 0x3 to DOQ_REQUEST_CANCELLED
requirements.statement: The value 0x3 MUST be assigned to DOQ_REQUEST_CANCELLED.

requirements.title: Assign 0x4 to DOQ_EXCESSIVE_LOAD
requirements.statement: The value 0x4 MUST be assigned to DOQ_EXCESSIVE_LOAD.

requirements.title: Assign 0x5 to DOQ_UNSPECIFIED_ERROR
requirements.statement: The value 0x5 MUST be assigned to DOQ_UNSPECIFIED_ERROR.

requirements.title: Assign 0xd098ea5e to DOQ_ERROR_RESERVED
requirements.statement: The value 0xd098ea5e MUST be assigned to DOQ_ERROR_RESERVED.

requirements.title: Allow NOTIFY in 0-RTT data
requirements.statement: A NOTIFY MAY be sent in 0-RTT data.

requirements.title: Advertise grease_quic_bit as an empty transport parameter
requirements.statement: An endpoint that implements RFC 9287 version 1 greasing MUST send grease_quic_bit (0x2ab2) as an empty transport parameter.

requirements.title: Reject non-empty grease_quic_bit values
requirements.statement: An endpoint that receives grease_quic_bit with a non-empty value MUST terminate the connection with TRANSPORT_PARAMETER_ERROR.

requirements.title: Allow cleared QUIC-bit transmission after transport-parameter processing
requirements.statement: After an endpoint has received and processed a peer's transport parameters carrying grease_quic_bit, the endpoint MAY send packets with the QUIC Bit cleared to 0.

requirements.title: Encode integer fields as QUIC variable-length integers
requirements.statement: Integer fields within types MUST be encoded using the variable-length integer encoding from Section 16 of QUIC.

requirements.title: Associate each HTTP Datagram with an HTTP request
requirements.statement: Each HTTP Datagram MUST be associated with an HTTP request.

requirements.title: Negotiate HTTP Datagrams with HTTP/3 settings
requirements.statement: The use of QUIC DATAGRAM frames for HTTP Datagrams MUST be negotiated via the exchange of HTTP/3 settings.

requirements.title: Define HTTP/3 Datagram field order
requirements.statement: An HTTP/3 Datagram MUST contain the Quarter Stream ID field followed by the HTTP Datagram Payload field.

requirements.title: Encode Quarter Stream ID from the associated stream ID
requirements.statement: The Quarter Stream ID field MUST contain the value of the associated client-initiated bidirectional stream ID divided by four.

requirements.title: Limit Quarter Stream ID to the legal maximum
requirements.statement: The Quarter Stream ID field MUST NOT exceed 2^60-1.

requirements.title: Treat oversized Quarter Stream ID values as a connection error
requirements.statement: Receipt of an HTTP/3 Datagram that includes a larger value MUST be treated as an HTTP/3 connection error of type H3_DATAGRAM_ERROR (0x33).

requirements.title: Treat undersized DATAGRAM payloads as a connection error
requirements.statement: Receipt of a QUIC DATAGRAM frame whose payload is too short to allow parsing the Quarter Stream ID field MUST be treated as an HTTP/3 connection error of type H3_DATAGRAM_ERROR (0x33).

requirements.title: Require an open send side before sending HTTP/3 Datagrams
requirements.statement: HTTP/3 Datagrams MUST NOT be sent unless the corresponding stream's send side is open.

requirements.title: Silently drop datagrams after stream close
requirements.statement: A receiver MUST silently drop any datagram received after the corresponding stream's receive side is closed.

requirements.title: Handle datagrams for uncreated streams
requirements.statement: If an HTTP/3 Datagram maps to a stream that has not yet been created, the receiver SHALL either silently drop the datagram or buffer it temporarily for about one round trip while awaiting creation of the corresponding stream.

requirements.title: Treat datagrams for uncreatable streams as H3_ID_ERROR
requirements.statement: If an HTTP/3 Datagram maps to a stream that cannot be created because of client-initiated bidirectional stream limits, the receiver SHOULD treat it as an HTTP/3 connection error of type H3_ID_ERROR.

requirements.title: Capsule Protocol start on HTTP/1.x connections
requirements.statement: On an HTTP/1.x connection, only the last HTTP request on that connection MAY start the Capsule Protocol.

requirements.title: Data streams obey underlying flow control
requirements.statement: Data streams MUST be subject to the flow control mechanisms of the underlying layers.

requirements.title: Capsule protocol uses capsule entries
requirements.statement: A Capsule Protocol data stream MUST contain Capsule entries.

requirements.title: Capsule field layout
requirements.statement: A Capsule MUST contain Capsule Type, Capsule Length, and Capsule Value fields in that order.

requirements.title: Capsule length encoding
requirements.statement: The Capsule Length field MUST be the length, in bytes, of the Capsule Value field that follows it, encoded as a variable-length integer.

requirements.title: Zero capsule length allowed
requirements.statement: The Capsule Length field MAY have a value of zero.

requirements.title: Detect capsule protocol use
requirements.statement: An intermediary MAY identify the use of the Capsule Protocol either through the presence of the Capsule-Protocol header field or by understanding the chosen HTTP Upgrade token.

requirements.title: Forward capsules without modification
requirements.statement: Intermediaries that wish to allow for future extensibility SHOULD forward Capsules without modification unless the definition of the Capsule Type in use specifies additional intermediary processing.

requirements.title: Capsule protocol response status precondition
requirements.statement: The Capsule Protocol MUST NOT be in use unless the response includes a 2xx (Successful) or 101 (Switching Protocols) status code.

requirements.title: No HTTP content with Capsule Protocol
requirements.statement: When the Capsule Protocol is in use, the associated HTTP request and response MUST NOT carry HTTP content.

requirements.title: Restrict Capsule Protocol to CONNECT in HTTP/2 and HTTP/3
requirements.statement: In HTTP/2 and HTTP/3, the Capsule Protocol MUST only be used with the CONNECT method.

requirements.title: Prohibit Content-Length with Capsule Protocol
requirements.statement: The Capsule Protocol MUST NOT be used with messages that contain Content-Length header fields.

requirements.title: Prohibit Content-Type with Capsule Protocol
requirements.statement: The Capsule Protocol MUST NOT be used with messages that contain Content-Type header fields.

requirements.title: Prohibit Transfer-Encoding with Capsule Protocol
requirements.statement: The Capsule Protocol MUST NOT be used with messages that contain Transfer-Encoding header fields.

requirements.title: Prohibit 204 responses with Capsule Protocol
requirements.statement: HTTP status code 204 (No Content) MUST NOT be sent on responses that use the Capsule Protocol.

requirements.title: Prohibit 205 responses with Capsule Protocol
requirements.statement: HTTP status code 205 (Reset Content) MUST NOT be sent on responses that use the Capsule Protocol.

requirements.title: Prohibit 206 responses with Capsule Protocol
requirements.statement: HTTP status code 206 (Partial Content) MUST NOT be sent on responses that use the Capsule Protocol.

requirements.title: Treat violations as malformed
requirements.statement: A receiver that observes a violation of these requirements MUST treat the HTTP message as malformed.

requirements.title: Avoid flow-control exhaustion deadlocks
requirements.statement: Implementations SHOULD avoid buffering the full Capsule Value before handling it.

requirements.title: Classify Capsule-Protocol as an Item Structured Field
requirements.statement: The Capsule-Protocol header field MUST be an Item Structured Field.

requirements.title: Require Capsule-Protocol values to be Boolean
requirements.statement: The Capsule-Protocol header field value MUST be a Boolean.

requirements.title: Signal Capsule Protocol use with a true header value
requirements.statement: Endpoints MUST indicate that the Capsule Protocol is in use on a data stream by sending a Capsule-Protocol header field with a true value.

requirements.title: Treat false Capsule-Protocol as absent
requirements.statement: A Capsule-Protocol header field with a false value MUST have the same semantics as when the header is not present.

requirements.title: Permit HTTP Datagrams in the DATAGRAM Capsule
requirements.statement: The DATAGRAM Capsule MUST allow HTTP Datagrams to be sent on a stream using the Capsule Protocol.

requirements.title: Place HTTP Datagram Payload after Length in the DATAGRAM Capsule
requirements.statement: In the DATAGRAM Capsule, the HTTP Datagram Payload MUST follow the Length field.

requirements.title: Place Length after Type in the DATAGRAM Capsule
requirements.statement: In the DATAGRAM Capsule, the Length field MUST follow the Type field.

requirements.title: Set DATAGRAM Capsule Type to 0x00
requirements.statement: The DATAGRAM Capsule Type MUST be 0x00.

requirements.title: DATAGRAM Capsule semantics match QUIC DATAGRAM frames
requirements.statement: HTTP Datagrams sent using the DATAGRAM Capsule MUST have the same semantics as those sent in QUIC DATAGRAM frames.

requirements.title: DATAGRAM Capsule inherits Section 2.1 restrictions
requirements.statement: The restrictions from Section 2.1 on when it is allowed to send an HTTP Datagram and how to process HTTP Datagrams MUST also apply to HTTP Datagrams sent and received using the DATAGRAM Capsule.

requirements.title: Avoid converting to DATAGRAM Capsule when DATAGRAM frames are supported
requirements.statement: If an intermediary receives an HTTP Datagram in a QUIC DATAGRAM frame and is forwarding it on a connection that supports QUIC DATAGRAM frames, the intermediary SHOULD not convert that HTTP Datagram to a DATAGRAM Capsule.

requirements.title: Take extension limits into account when parsing DATAGRAM Capsules
requirements.statement: Implementations SHOULD take extension limits into account when parsing DATAGRAM Capsules.

requirements.title: Discard unusable DATAGRAM Capsules without buffering
requirements.statement: If an incoming DATAGRAM Capsule has a length known to be unusable, the implementation SHOULD discard it without buffering its contents into memory.

requirements.title: Avoid accumulating entire Capsules before re-encoding
requirements.statement: Implementations SHOULD avoid accumulating the entire Capsule in the stream before re-encoding DATAGRAM Capsules into QUIC DATAGRAM frames.

requirements.title: Use the Capsule Protocol for new HTTP extensions that use HTTP Datagrams
requirements.statement: New HTTP extensions that wish to use HTTP Datagrams SHOULD use the Capsule Protocol.

requirements.title: Assign value 0x33 to SETTINGS_H3_DATAGRAM
requirements.statement: The SETTINGS_H3_DATAGRAM setting MUST have value 0x33.

requirements.title: Set the SETTINGS_H3_DATAGRAM default to 0
requirements.statement: The default value of SETTINGS_H3_DATAGRAM MUST be 0.

requirements.title: Assign code 0x33 to H3_DATAGRAM_ERROR
requirements.statement: The H3_DATAGRAM_ERROR code MUST have value 0x33.

requirements.title: Register Capsule-Protocol as the HTTP field name
requirements.statement: The HTTP field name registry entry MUST list Capsule-Protocol as the field name.

requirements.title: Reserve 0x29N+0x17 Capsule Types
requirements.statement: Capsule Types with a value of the form 0x29 * N + 0x17 MUST be reserved.

requirements.title: DATAGRAM capsule type value
requirements.statement: The DATAGRAM capsule type MUST use value 0x00.

requirements.title: Interpret stream as connection without multiplexing
requirements.statement: When the HTTP version in use does not support multiplexing streams, a reference to "stream" in this document MUST represent the entire connection.

requirements.title: Start path with slash
requirements.statement: The path component of the URI Template MUST start with a slash ("/").

requirements.title: Keep template variables in path or query
requirements.statement: All template variables MUST be within the path or query components of the URI.

requirements.title: Allow other template variables
requirements.statement: The URI Template MAY contain other variables.

requirements.title: Require target_host and target_port
requirements.statement: The URI Template MUST contain the variables "target_host" and "target_port".

requirements.title: Disallow non-ASCII characters
requirements.statement: The URI Template MUST NOT contain any non-ASCII Unicode characters.

requirements.title: Restrict URI Template to printable ASCII
requirements.statement: The URI Template MUST only contain characters in the ASCII range 0x21-0x7E inclusive.

requirements.title: Disallow dot-prefix label expansion
requirements.statement: The URI Template MUST NOT use Label Expansion with Dot-Prefix.

requirements.title: Disallow fragment expansion
requirements.statement: The URI Template MUST NOT use Fragment Expansion ("#" operator).

requirements.title: Disallow reserved expansion
requirements.statement: The URI Template MUST NOT use Reserved Expansion ("+" operator).

requirements.title: Disallow semicolon-prefix path-style parameter expansion
requirements.statement: The URI Template MUST NOT use Path-Style Parameter Expansion with Semicolon-Prefix.

requirements.title: Disallow slash-prefix path segment expansion
requirements.statement: The URI Template MUST NOT use Path Segment Expansion with Slash-Prefix.

requirements.title: Allow general-purpose URI Template implementations
requirements.statement: Clients MAY use a general-purpose URI Template implementation that lacks this specific validation.

requirements.title: Recommend validating URI Template requirements
requirements.statement: Clients SHOULD validate the URI Template requirements above.

requirements.title: Reject invalid URI Template configuration
requirements.statement: If a client detects that any of the requirements above are not met by a URI Template, the client MUST reject its configuration and abort the request without sending it to the UDP proxy.

requirements.title: Allow constrained clients to use the default template
requirements.statement: Clients constrained by such limitations MAY attempt to access UDP proxying capabilities using the default template `https://$PROXY_HOST:$PROXY_PORT/.well-known/masque/udp/{target_host}/{target_port}/`.

requirements.title: Recommend offering service at the default template location
requirements.statement: UDP proxy deployments SHOULD offer service at this location if they need to interoperate with such clients.

requirements.title: Use HTTP Datagrams in the Section 5 format
requirements.statement: UDP tunnels MUST use HTTP Datagrams in the format defined in Section 5.

requirements.title: Use the Capsule Protocol for UDP tunnels
requirements.statement: UDP tunnels MUST use the Capsule Protocol.

requirements.title: Initiate a UDP tunnel with the connect-udp token
requirements.statement: A client MUST issue a request containing the `connect-udp` upgrade token to initiate a UDP tunnel associated with a single HTTP stream.

requirements.title: Disallow IPv6 scoped addressing zone identifiers
requirements.statement: The `target_host` variable MUST NOT use IPv6 scoped addressing zone identifiers.

requirements.title: Adhere to the Figure 2 format for target_host and target_port
requirements.statement: The `target_host` and `target_port` variables MUST adhere to the format in Figure 2, using notation from ABNF.

requirements.title: Require a non-empty target_host
requirements.statement: The `target_host` variable MUST NOT be empty.

requirements.title: Require a non-empty target_port
requirements.statement: The `target_port` variable MUST NOT be empty.

requirements.title: Percent-encode IPv6 literal colons in target_host
requirements.statement: If `target_host` contains an IPv6 literal, the colons (`:`) MUST be percent-encoded.

requirements.title: Constrain target_port to the valid port range
requirements.statement: `target_port` MUST represent an integer between 1 and 65535 inclusive.

requirements.title: Target host syntax
requirements.statement: The `target_host` value MUST be an IPv6address, an IPv4address, or a reg-name.

requirements.title: Target port syntax
requirements.statement: The `target_port` value MUST be a port.

requirements.title: Expand URI template for request path and query
requirements.statement: When sending its UDP proxying request, the client SHALL perform URI Template expansion to determine the path and query of its request.

requirements.title: Convert HTTP Datagrams and UDP packets after a successful request
requirements.statement: If the request is successful, the UDP proxy MUST convert received HTTP Datagrams into UDP packets and UDP packets into HTTP Datagrams until the tunnel is closed.

requirements.title: Requests carry no message content
requirements.statement: UDP proxying requests MUST NOT carry any message content.

requirements.title: Successful responses carry no message content
requirements.statement: Successful UDP proxying responses MUST NOT carry any message content.

requirements.title: Send Proxy-Status details on errors
requirements.statement: If errors occur during this process, the UDP proxy SHOULD send details using an appropriate Proxy-Status header field [PROXY-STATUS].

requirements.title: Keep socket open while request stream is open
requirements.statement: The UDP proxy MUST keep the socket open while the request stream is open.

requirements.title: Close request stream when socket is unusable
requirements.statement: If a UDP proxy is notified by its operating system that its socket is no longer usable, it MUST close the request stream.

requirements.title: Allow closing sockets after inactivity
requirements.statement: UDP proxies MAY choose to close sockets due to a period of inactivity.

requirements.title: Close request stream when closing socket
requirements.statement: When closing the socket, UDP proxies MUST close the request stream.

requirements.title: Avoid short inactivity timeouts
requirements.statement: UDP proxies that close sockets after a period of inactivity SHOULD NOT use a period lower than two minutes.

requirements.title: Abort request on non-success response
requirements.statement: Any response other than a successful response indicates that the request has failed; thus, the client MUST abort the request.

requirements.title: Avoid IP fragmentation for HTTP Datagrams
requirements.statement: UDP proxies MUST NOT introduce fragmentation at the IP layer when forwarding HTTP Datagrams onto a UDP socket.

requirements.title: Silently drop oversized datagrams
requirements.statement: UDP proxies MUST silently drop overly large datagrams when forwarding HTTP Datagrams onto a UDP socket.

requirements.title: Set IPv4 DF bit when possible
requirements.statement: In IPv4, the Don't Fragment (DF) bit MUST be set, if possible, to prevent fragmentation on the path.

requirements.title: Use GET method
requirements.statement: The method SHALL be "GET".

requirements.title: Include a single Host header field
requirements.statement: The request MUST include a single Host header field containing the origin of the UDP proxy.

requirements.title: Include Connection header field value Upgrade
requirements.statement: The request MUST include a Connection header field with value "Upgrade", compared case-insensitively.

requirements.title: Include Upgrade header field value connect-udp
requirements.statement: The request MUST include an Upgrade header field with value "connect-udp".

requirements.title: Respond with an error to malformed requests
requirements.statement: The recipient of such a malformed request MUST respond with an error.

requirements.title: Use 400 Bad Request for malformed requests
requirements.statement: The recipient of such a malformed request SHOULD use the 400 (Bad Request) status code.

requirements.title: Respond with 101 Switching Protocols
requirements.statement: The HTTP status code on the response MUST be 101 (Switching Protocols).

requirements.title: Include single Upgrade header field value connect-udp in response
requirements.statement: The response MUST include a single Upgrade header field with value "connect-udp".

requirements.title: Meet Capsule Protocol response requirements
requirements.statement: The response SHALL meet the requirements of HTTP responses that start the Capsule Protocol.

requirements.title: Abort failed proxying attempts
requirements.statement: If any of these requirements are not met, the client MUST treat this proxying attempt as failed and abort the connection.

requirements.title: Send HTTP Setting
requirements.statement: Servers MUST send an HTTP Setting as specified in [EXT-CONNECT2] and [EXT-CONNECT3].

requirements.title: Set :method to CONNECT
requirements.statement: The :method pseudo-header field MUST be "CONNECT".

requirements.title: Set :protocol to connect-udp
requirements.statement: The :protocol pseudo-header field MUST be "connect-udp".

requirements.title: Set :authority to the UDP proxy authority
requirements.statement: The :authority pseudo-header field MUST contain the authority of the UDP proxy.

requirements.title: Require non-empty :path and :scheme
requirements.statement: The :path and :scheme pseudo-header fields MUST NOT be empty.

requirements.title: Populate :path and :scheme from the URI Template
requirements.statement: Their values MUST contain the scheme and path from the URI Template after URI Template expansion completes.

requirements.title: Response status code in 2xx range
requirements.statement: The HTTP status code on the response MUST be in the 2xx (Successful) range.

requirements.title: Meet Capsule Protocol response requirements
requirements.statement: The response MUST meet the requirements of HTTP responses that start the Capsule Protocol; see Section 3.2 of [HTTP-DGRAM].

requirements.title: Abort failed proxying attempts
requirements.statement: If any of these requirements are not met, the client MUST treat this proxying attempt as failed and abort the request.

requirements.title: Allow any allocation order for Context IDs
requirements.statement: Context IDs MAY be allocated in any order.

requirements.title: Allow allocated Context IDs to be used by any client or UDP proxy
requirements.statement: Once a Context ID has been allocated, any client or UDP proxy MAY use it regardless of which endpoint initially allocated it.

requirements.title: Context ID follows Quarter Stream ID in QUIC DATAGRAM frames
requirements.statement: When HTTP Datagrams are encoded using QUIC DATAGRAM frames, the Context ID field MUST directly follow the Quarter Stream ID field.

requirements.title: UDP Proxying HTTP Datagram Payload layout
requirements.statement: The UDP Proxying HTTP Datagram Payload MUST contain a Context ID field followed by a UDP Proxying Payload field.

requirements.title: Prohibit oversized HTTP Datagrams
requirements.statement: Endpoints MUST NOT send HTTP Datagrams with a UDP Proxying Payload longer than 65527 bytes when Context ID is zero.

requirements.title: Abort streams for oversized received datagrams
requirements.statement: An endpoint that receives an HTTP Datagram with Context ID zero and a UDP Proxying Payload longer than 65527 bytes MUST abort the corresponding stream.

requirements.title: Discard oversized datagrams when MTU is known
requirements.statement: A UDP proxy that knows its outgoing UDP packet length is limited by the underlying link MTU MUST discard incoming HTTP Datagrams with Context ID zero and a UDP Proxying Payload longer than that limit.

requirements.title: Discard DATAGRAM capsules for discarded datagrams
requirements.statement: If the discarded HTTP Datagram was transported by a DATAGRAM capsule, the receiver SHOULD discard the capsule without buffering its contents.

requirements.title: Handle early HTTP Datagrams by drop or temporary buffering
requirements.statement: If a UDP proxy receives an HTTP Datagram before the corresponding request, it SHALL either drop it silently or buffer it temporarily for about one round trip while awaiting the request.

requirements.title: Apply buffering limits to buffered datagrams
requirements.statement: Receivers that buffer datagrams SHOULD apply buffering limits to reduce the risk of resource exhaustion.

requirements.title: Allow optimistic datagram sending before response
requirements.statement: A client MAY send UDP packets in HTTP Datagrams before receiving the response to its UDP proxying request.

requirements.title: Drop UDP payload in this scenario
requirements.statement: The UDP proxy SHOULD drop the UDP payload.

requirements.title: Send ICMP Packet Too Big to target in this scenario
requirements.statement: The UDP proxy SHOULD send an ICMP Packet Too Big message to the target.

requirements.title: No inner IP header in UDP proxying tunnels
requirements.statement: UDP proxying tunnels MUST NOT include an inner IP header.

requirements.title: Clients cannot control ECN codepoints on proxied UDP packets
requirements.statement: The UDP proxy MUST retain control of the ECN codepoints on UDP packets it sends to the target.

requirements.title: UDP proxies cannot communicate per-packet markings to clients
requirements.statement: UDP proxies MUST NOT communicate per-packet markings from the target to the UDP proxy.

requirements.title: Disallow UDP proxying to vulnerable targets
requirements.statement: UDP proxies MUST disallow UDP proxying requests to vulnerable targets, such as the proxy's own addresses and localhost, link-local, multicast, and broadcast addresses.

requirements.title: Use destination_ip_prohibited when rejecting disallowed requests
requirements.statement: UDP proxies MAY use the destination_ip_prohibited Proxy Error Type from Section 2.3.5 of PROXY-STATUS when rejecting such requests.

requirements.title: Document connection ID privacy boundary
requirements.statement: Application-facing documentation MUST describe the supported connection-ID privacy boundary without claiming broader timing-linkability mitigation.

requirements.title: Document version deployment boundary
requirements.statement: Application-facing documentation MUST distinguish implemented version-negotiation mechanisms from operator rollout policy for new QUIC versions.

requirements.title: Document DATAGRAM applicability boundary
requirements.statement: Application-facing documentation MUST distinguish the RFC 9221 QUIC DATAGRAM transport floor from HTTP Datagrams, CONNECT-UDP, and MASQUE behavior.

requirements.title: Keep public application 0-RTT profile gated
requirements.statement: Public application 0-RTT MUST remain unavailable until an application profile defines replay-safe early-data semantics.

requirements.title: Separate keep-alive from resumption
requirements.statement: Application-facing documentation MUST distinguish connection keep-alive behavior from TLS session resumption and 0-RTT application data.

requirements.title: Document application stream mapping
requirements.statement: Application protocols MUST explicitly map QUIC streams to their protocol roles and message boundaries.

requirements.title: Expose flow-control blocked backpressure
requirements.statement: Application send paths that become flow-control blocked MUST preserve stream state and expose blocked-credit diagnostics.

requirements.title: Expose stream-limit blocked backpressure
requirements.statement: Application stream-open paths that become stream-limit blocked MUST preserve stream state and expose blocked-stream diagnostics.

requirements.title: Keep application close codes separate
requirements.statement: Application close error codes MUST remain distinct from QUIC transport error codes.

requirements.title: Validate migration candidates before promotion
requirements.statement: NAT rebinding and migration candidates MUST remain unpromoted until path validation succeeds.

requirements.title: Expose safe packet header visibility diagnostics
requirements.statement: Transport diagnostics MUST expose safe packet header form and packet-type metadata without logging protected payload bytes.

requirements.title: Expose coalesced packet processing diagnostics
requirements.statement: Coalesced UDP datagram processing MUST expose safe packet-count diagnostics.

requirements.title: Expose safe connection ID lifecycle diagnostics
requirements.statement: Connection ID issuance, retirement, and first path use MUST be observable without logging raw connection ID bytes or stateless reset tokens.

requirements.title: Expose migration and path validation diagnostics
requirements.statement: NAT rebinding, migration, and path validation MUST emit safe diagnostics for challenge, success, failure, timeout, and path promotion state.

requirements.title: Expose safe operational failure diagnostics
requirements.statement: PMTU, ICMP Packet Too Big, UDP error, anti-amplification, close, draining, stateless reset, and spin-bit diagnostics MUST expose only production-safe metadata.

requirements.title: Emit authenticated Version Information
requirements.statement: An endpoint that supports compatible version negotiation MUST encode Version Information in the `version_information` transport parameter with a non-zero Chosen Version and a list of Available Versions that includes the Chosen Version when the endpoint acts as a client.

requirements.title: Recognize QUIC version 2 long headers
requirements.statement: An endpoint that supports QUIC version 2 MUST accept 0x6B3343CF as a supported transport version and use the version-specific bit assignments defined by RFC 9369 when encoding and decoding long-header packet types.

requirements.title: Use the RFC 9369 Initial salt and labels
requirements.statement: A QUIC v2 endpoint MUST derive and validate Initial packet protection using the RFC 9369 Initial salt and the `quicv2 key`, `quicv2 iv`, and `quicv2 hp` labels, keeping v1 and v2 Initial protection material distinct.

requirements.title: Use the RFC 9369 Retry integrity key and nonce
requirements.statement: A QUIC v2 endpoint MUST generate and validate Retry integrity tags using the RFC 9369 v2 Retry secret material, keeping Retry metadata bound to the version carried by the Retry packet.

requirements.title: DNS service SVCB name formation
requirements.statement: SVCB record names (QNAMEs) for DNS services MUST be formed using Port Prefix Naming with the scheme "dns".

requirements.title: Authentication name format
requirements.statement: The authentication name MUST be a DNS hostname or a literal IP address.

requirements.title: Default DNS port for unencrypted UDP/TCP
requirements.statement: When connecting to the service using unencrypted DNS over UDP or TCP, clients MUST use port 53.

requirements.title: Non-default port prefix naming
requirements.statement: When the binding authority specifies a non-default port number, Port Prefix Naming MUST place the port number in an additional prefix on the name.

requirements.title: Treat records as incompatible when ALPN is absent
requirements.statement: If the "alpn" SvcParamKey is absent, the client MUST treat the SVCB record as "incompatible" unless some other recognized SvcParam indicates a supported protocol.

requirements.title: Require dohpath when HTTP versions are present
requirements.statement: If the protocol set contains any HTTP versions (e.g., "h2", "h3"), the "dohpath" key MUST be present.

requirements.title: HTTPS record keys apply to the resulting HTTP connection
requirements.statement: All SvcParamKeys specified for use with the HTTPS record MUST be permissible and apply to the resulting HTTP connection.

requirements.title: Separate protocols with different default ports when no port is specified
requirements.statement: If the protocol set contains protocols with different default ports and no "port" key is specified, a client MUST contact the protocols separately on their respective default ports.

requirements.title: Use default ports when omitted
requirements.statement: If omitted, the client SHALL use the default port number for each transport protocol (853 for DoT and DoQ, 443 for DoH).

requirements.title: Ignore records containing unsupported port keys
requirements.statement: A client that does not respect the "port" key MUST ignore any SVCB record that contains this key.

requirements.title: Avoid AliasMode records when resolution speed is high
requirements.statement: Where resolution speed is a high priority, AliasMode records SHOULD be avoided.

requirements.title: Follow the TargetName convention when resolution speed is high
requirements.statement: Where resolution speed is a high priority, the SVCB TargetName SHOULD follow the convention described in Section 10.2 of [SVCB].

requirements.title: Register the dohpath IANA entry
requirements.statement: IANA MUST register number 7 as `dohpath` for the DNS-over-HTTPS path template.

requirements.title: Register the _dns node name
requirements.statement: IANA MUST register `_dns` as the node name for SVCB.

requirements.title: Assign the RR type SVCB
requirements.statement: The RR type MUST be `SVCB` (64).

requirements.title: Discourage cleartext fallback
requirements.statement: Cleartext fallback SHOULD NOT be used.

requirements.title: Make port mandatory
requirements.statement: The `port` key MUST be automatically mandatory.

requirements.title: Map the scheme to dns
requirements.statement: The mapped scheme MUST be `dns`.

requirements.title: Override HTTPS RR for DoH
requirements.statement: The mapping MUST override the HTTPS RR for DoH.

requirements.title: Require alpn or equivalent
requirements.statement: The mapping MUST require `alpn` or an equivalent key.

requirements.title: Set the name prefix by port
requirements.statement: The name prefix MUST be `_dns` for port 53 and `_$PORT._dns` otherwise.

requirements.title: Support HTTPS SvcParamKeys
requirements.statement: The mapping MUST support all HTTPS RR SvcParamKeys.

requirements.title: Use a per-transport default port
requirements.statement: The default port MUST be per-transport.

requirements.title: Parse ServiceMode DNS SVCB RDATA wire values
requirements.statement: The DNS service binding parser MUST parse ServiceMode SVCB RDATA as SvcPriority, uncompressed fully qualified TargetName, and strictly increasing SvcParams, decoding `alpn`, `port`, and `dohpath` SvcParamValues into RFC 9461 scalar endpoint-selection values while rejecting AliasMode, compressed names, malformed SvcParam ordering, truncated fields, invalid ALPN values, invalid port values, and invalid dohpath values.

requirements.title: Resolve AliasMode DNS SVCB chains to ServiceMode records
requirements.statement: The DNS service binding resolver MUST parse AliasMode SVCB RDATA as priority zero plus an uncompressed TargetName with no SvcParams, follow AliasMode owner-to-target chains to ServiceMode SVCB records, and report loops, missing targets, malformed AliasMode RDATA, compressed target names, non-zero priorities, and AliasMode records carrying SvcParams without performing DNS message parsing, Additional-section address processing, DNSSEC validation, operator publication, host resolver installation, or encrypted DNS session establishment.

requirements.title: Parse DNS service binding responses and Additional addresses
requirements.statement: The DNS service binding response parser MUST parse DNS response headers, questions, answer records, authority records, and Additional records; decode SVCB answer records into AliasMode and ServiceMode records; extract Internet-class Additional-section A and AAAA address records; skip unsupported record types and non-Internet address records; and reject truncated messages, cyclic or invalid compressed names, malformed SVCB RDATA, malformed A or AAAA RDATA, and trailing bytes without performing DNSSEC validation, operator publication, host resolver installation, or encrypted DNS session establishment.

requirements.title: Generate deterministic DNS service binding publication records
requirements.statement: The DNS service binding publication planner MUST generate deterministic presentation-format SVCB records from validated DNS service binding values, include an equivalent HTTPS record when operator guidance recommends one and the service binding advertises HTTP protocols, avoid AliasMode in fast-resolution publication plans, preserve RFC 9461 `alpn`, `port`, `dohpath`, and HTTPS service-parameter values, and reject invalid TargetName and TTL inputs without performing live DNS provider publication, DNSSEC signing, host resolver installation, or encrypted DNS session establishment.

requirements.title: Preference-ordered multiple IP addresses
requirements.statement: If multiple IP addresses are returned in an Encrypted DNS option, they MUST be returned ordered by preference.

requirements.title: Encode service parameters with the RFC9460 wire format
requirements.statement: These parameters MUST be encoded following the same rules for encoding SvcParams using the wire format specified in Section 2.2 of [RFC9460].

requirements.title: Prefer ADN-only provisioning mode
requirements.statement: ADN-only provisioning mode SHOULD be used.

requirements.title: ADN presence and encoding
requirements.statement: The ADN MUST be present and encoded as specified in Section 10 of RFC 8415.

requirements.title: Service parameter encoding rules
requirements.statement: The service parameters MUST be encoded according to Section 2.2 of RFC 9460.

requirements.title: At least one valid IP address
requirements.statement: The Encrypted DNS option MUST include at least one valid IP address.

requirements.title: No hint parameters in service parameters
requirements.statement: The service parameters MUST exclude "ipv4hint" and "ipv6hint" parameters.

requirements.title: Discard invalid Encrypted DNS option
requirements.statement: If any validation check fails, the receiver MUST discard the received Encrypted DNS option.

requirements.title: Service priority when implicit ordering is absent
requirements.statement: When multiple encrypted DNS instances are used and implicit ordering is not relied on, the DNR information SHOULD include a service priority.

requirements.title: Mandatory ADN parameter
requirements.statement: The ADN parameter MUST be present in the DNR information.

requirements.title: Resolver IP address list
requirements.statement: The DNR information SHOULD include IP addresses used to locate the encrypted DNS resolver.

requirements.title: Service parameter set
requirements.statement: The DNR information SHOULD include a set of service parameters.

requirements.title: Prefer encrypted DNS when both resolver types are learned
requirements.statement: If a client learns both Do53 and encrypted DNS resolvers from the same network, and there is no explicit configuration to the contrary, the client SHOULD use the encrypted DNS resolvers for that network.

requirements.title: Allow fallback to Do53 when encrypted DNS connection fails
requirements.statement: If the client cannot establish an authenticated and encrypted connection with the encrypted DNS resolver, it MAY fall back to using the Do53 resolver.

requirements.title: Establish sessions according to discovered resolver priority
requirements.statement: If the local DNS client supports one of the discovered encrypted DNS protocols identified by ALPN protocol identifiers or another service parameter that indicates another protocol disambiguation mechanism, the DNS client MUST establish an encrypted DNS session following the service priority of the discovered encrypted resolvers.

requirements.title: Validate resolver certificates and ADN using PKIX and RFC6125
requirements.statement: The DNS client MUST verify the connection using PKIX validation of the DNS resolver certificate and compare the ADN conveyed in the Encrypted DNS options to the certificate using RFC6125 validation techniques.

requirements.title: Encode the OPTION_V6_DNR option format
requirements.statement: The OPTION_V6_DNR option format MUST be encoded with OPTION_V6_DNR, Option-length, Service Priority, ADN Length, authentication-domain-name, Addr Length, ipv6-address(es), and Service Parameters (SvcParams) in that order.

requirements.title: Set the OPTION_V6_DNR option code
requirements.statement: The OPTION_V6_DNR option code MUST be 144.

requirements.title: Set Option-length to the enclosed data size
requirements.statement: The Option-length field MUST be the length of the enclosed data in octets.

requirements.title: Set Option-length when only ADN is present
requirements.statement: When only an ADN is included in the option, the option length MUST be the ADN Length plus 4.

requirements.title: Interpret Service Priority as a 16-bit unsigned integer
requirements.statement: The Service Priority field MUST be interpreted as a 16-bit unsigned integer following the rules specified in Section 2.4.1 of [RFC9460].

requirements.title: Define ADN Length field
requirements.statement: The ADN Length field MUST be the length of the authentication-domain-name field in octets.

requirements.title: Define authentication-domain-name field
requirements.statement: The authentication-domain-name field MUST be a Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) of the encrypted DNS resolver.

requirements.title: Format authentication-domain-name field
requirements.statement: The authentication-domain-name field MUST be formatted as specified in Section 10 of [RFC8415].

requirements.title: Define Addr Length field
requirements.statement: The Addr Length field MUST be the length of enclosed IPv6 addresses in octets.

requirements.title: Constrain Addr Length multiple
requirements.statement: When present, the Addr Length field MUST be a multiple of 16.

requirements.title: IPv6 address semantics
requirements.statement: The `ipv6-address(es)` field MUST indicate one or more IPv6 addresses to reach the encrypted DNS resolver.

requirements.title: IPv6 address field layout
requirements.statement: The `ipv6-address` field MUST use the variable-length layout shown in Figure 3.

requirements.title: SvcParams encoding
requirements.statement: The Service Parameters (SvcParams) field MUST be a variable-length set of service parameters encoded following the rules in Section 2.2 of RFC9460.

requirements.title: Prefer alpn SvcParam
requirements.statement: The SvcParams field SHOULD include the "alpn" SvcParam.

requirements.title: Exclude superseded SvcParams
requirements.statement: The service parameters MUST omit "ipv4hint" and "ipv6hint" SvcParams.

requirements.title: Use default port numbers when port service parameter is omitted
requirements.statement: If no port service parameter is included, the default port numbers SHOULD be 853 for DoT, 443 for DoH, and 853 for DoQ.

requirements.title: Compute field length
requirements.statement: The field length MUST equal ('Option-length' - 6 - 'ADN Length' - 'Addr Length').

requirements.title: Omit fields in ADN-only mode
requirements.statement: When ADN-only mode is used, the `Addr Length`, `ipv6-address(es)`, and `Service Parameters (SvcParams)` fields MUST be absent.

requirements.title: Define OPTION_V4_DNR option format
requirements.statement: An OPTION_V4_DNR option MUST have a Length field followed by DNR Instance Data.

requirements.title: Define OPTION_V4_DNR code
requirements.statement: The OPTION_V4_DNR option code MUST be 162.

requirements.title: Length field semantics
requirements.statement: The Length field MUST indicate the length of the enclosed data in octets.

requirements.title: Define DNR Instance Data format
requirements.statement: A DNR Instance Data block MUST encode the fields DNR Instance Data Length, Service Priority, ADN Length, authentication-domain-name, Addr Length, IPv4 Address(es), and Service Parameters in the order shown.

requirements.title: Repeat DNR Instance Data for multiple resolvers
requirements.statement: When several encrypted DNS resolvers are to be included, the DNR Instance Data field MUST be repeated.

requirements.title: DNR Instance Data Length field semantics
requirements.statement: The DNR Instance Data Length field MUST indicate the length of all following data in octets.

requirements.title: Set DNR Instance Data Length for ADN-only instances
requirements.statement: When only an ADN is provided for a DNR instance, the DNR Instance Data Length field MUST be set to ADN Length + 3.

requirements.title: Interpret Service Priority per RFC9460
requirements.statement: The Service Priority field MUST be interpreted following the rules specified in Section 2.4.1 of [RFC9460].

requirements.title: Define ADN Length semantics
requirements.statement: The ADN Length field MUST be the length of the authentication-domain-name field in octets.

requirements.title: Define authentication-domain-name contents
requirements.statement: The authentication-domain-name field MUST contain the ADN of the encrypted DNS resolver.

requirements.title: Format authentication-domain-name per RFC8415
requirements.statement: The authentication-domain-name field MUST be formatted as specified in Section 10 of [RFC8415].

requirements.title: Define Addr Length semantics
requirements.statement: The Addr Length field MUST be the length of included IPv4 addresses in octets.

requirements.title: Require Addr Length to be a multiple of 4
requirements.statement: When present, the Addr Length field MUST be a multiple of 4.

requirements.title: Define IPv4 Address(es) contents
requirements.statement: The IPv4 Address(es) field MUST indicate one or more IPv4 addresses to reach the encrypted DNS resolver.

requirements.title: Allow private and public IPv4 addresses
requirements.statement: The IPv4 Address(es) field MAY include both private and public IPv4 addresses.

requirements.title: Encode Service Parameters per RFC9460
requirements.statement: The SvcParams field MUST be encoded following the rules in Section 2.2 of [RFC9460].

requirements.title: Include ALPN SvcParam
requirements.statement: The SvcParams field SHOULD include at least the "alpn" SvcParam.

requirements.title: Exclude ipv4hint SvcParam
requirements.statement: The service parameters MUST NOT include "ipv4hint".

requirements.title: Exclude ipv6hint SvcParam
requirements.statement: The service parameters MUST NOT include "ipv6hint".

requirements.title: Use Default Ports When No Port Service Parameter Is Present
requirements.statement: Default port numbers SHOULD be used if no port service parameter is included.

requirements.title: Compute Field Length From Component Lengths
requirements.statement: The length of this field MUST equal ('DNR Instance Data Length' - 4 - 'ADN Length' - 'Addr Length').

requirements.title: Omit Addr Length in ADN-Only Mode
requirements.statement: The "Addr Length" field MUST NOT be present in ADN-only mode.

requirements.title: Omit IPv4 Address Fields in ADN-Only Mode
requirements.statement: The "IPv4 Address(es)" field MUST NOT be present in ADN-only mode.

requirements.title: Omit Service Parameters in ADN-Only Mode
requirements.statement: The "Service Parameters (SvcParams)" field MUST NOT be present in ADN-only mode.

requirements.title: Use RFC3396 for Oversized OPTION_V4_DNR
requirements.statement: The mechanism specified in [RFC3396] MUST be used if OPTION_V4_DNR exceeds 255 octets.

requirements.title: Treat Each DNR Instance Data Entry Separately
requirements.statement: Each "DNR Instance Data" entry MUST be treated as a separate encrypted DNS resolver.

requirements.title: Discard Host Loopback Addresses
requirements.statement: The DHCPv4 client MUST silently discard host loopback addresses conveyed in OPTION_V4_DNR.

requirements.title: Discard Multicast Addresses
requirements.statement: The DHCPv4 client MUST silently discard multicast addresses conveyed in OPTION_V4_DNR.

requirements.title: Encrypted DNS option field order
requirements.statement: The Encrypted DNS option MUST use the field order Type, Length, Service Priority, Lifetime, ADN Length, authentication-domain-name, Addr Length, ipv6-address(es), SvcParams Length, and Service Parameters.

requirements.title: Encrypted DNS option type value
requirements.statement: The Type field MUST be the IANA-assigned 8-bit identifier for the Encrypted DNS option (144).

requirements.title: Encrypted DNS option length field encoding
requirements.statement: The Length field MUST be an 8-bit unsigned integer.

requirements.title: Encrypted DNS option length units
requirements.statement: The option length, including the Type and Length fields, MUST be measured in units of 8 octets.

requirements.title: Encrypted DNS service priority field encoding
requirements.statement: The Service Priority field MUST be a 16-bit unsigned integer.

requirements.title: Field interpretation follows RFC 9460
requirements.statement: The field MUST be interpreted following the rules specified in Section 2.4.1 of RFC 9460.

requirements.title: Lifetime field type
requirements.statement: Lifetime MUST be a 32-bit unsigned integer.

requirements.title: Lifetime validity semantics
requirements.statement: Lifetime MUST represent the maximum time in seconds, relative to the time the packet is received, over which the discovered ADN is valid.

requirements.title: Default Lifetime recommendation
requirements.statement: The value of Lifetime SHOULD by default be at least 3 * MaxRtrAdvInterval, where MaxRtrAdvInterval is the maximum RA interval as defined in RFC 4861.

requirements.title: Infinity encoding
requirements.statement: A value of all one bits (0xffffffff) MUST represent infinity.

requirements.title: Zero value retires ADN
requirements.statement: A value of zero MUST indicate that this ADN is no longer used.

requirements.title: ADN Length encoding
requirements.statement: The ADN Length field MUST be a 16-bit unsigned integer.

requirements.title: ADN Length meaning
requirements.statement: The ADN Length field MUST indicate the length of the authentication-domain-name field in octets.

requirements.title: authentication-domain-name contents
requirements.statement: The authentication-domain-name field MUST contain the ADN of the encrypted DNS resolver.

requirements.title: authentication-domain-name RFC 8415 formatting
requirements.statement: The authentication-domain-name field MUST be formatted as specified in Section 10 of RFC 8415.

requirements.title: Addr Length encoding
requirements.statement: The Addr Length field MUST be a 16-bit unsigned integer.

requirements.title: Addr Length meaning
requirements.statement: The Addr Length field MUST indicate the length of the enclosed IPv6 addresses in octets.

requirements.title: Addr Length multiple of 16
requirements.statement: When present, the Addr Length field MUST be a multiple of 16.

requirements.title: ipv6-address(es) contents
requirements.statement: The ipv6-address(es) field MUST contain one or more IPv6 addresses of the encrypted DNS resolver.

requirements.title: Shared Lifetime value across addresses
requirements.statement: All addresses in the option MUST share the same Lifetime value.

requirements.title: SvcParams Length field type
requirements.statement: The SvcParams Length field MUST be a 16-bit unsigned integer.

requirements.title: SvcParams Length field semantics
requirements.statement: The SvcParams Length field MUST indicate the length of the Service Parameters (SvcParams) field in octets.

requirements.title: SvcParams encoding follows RFC9460
requirements.statement: The Service Parameters (SvcParams) field MUST be encoded following the rules in Section 2.2 of RFC9460.

requirements.title: SvcParams field variable length
requirements.statement: The Service Parameters (SvcParams) field MUST be variable length.

requirements.title: Include alpn SvcParam
requirements.statement: The field SHOULD include at least the "alpn" SvcParam.

requirements.title: Exclude ipv4hint and ipv6hint SvcParams
requirements.statement: The service parameters MUST exclude "ipv4hint" or "ipv6hint" SvcParams.

requirements.title: Default port numbers when port parameter absent
requirements.statement: If no port service parameter is included, default port numbers SHOULD be used.

requirements.title: Omit fields in ADN-only mode
requirements.statement: When ADN-only mode is used, the Addr Length, ipv6-address(es), and Service Parameters (SvcParams) fields MUST be absent.

requirements.title: Pad option to 8-octet boundary
requirements.statement: The option MUST be padded with zeros so that the full enclosed data is a multiple of 8 octets.

requirements.title: Process received Encrypted DNS options
requirements.statement: The host MUST process received Encrypted DNS options using the RFC 8106 Section 5.3.1 procedure, substituting the Section 6.1 formatting requirements and Section 3.1.8 validation checks for length and field validations.

requirements.title: Discard host loopback encrypted DNS addresses
requirements.statement: The host MUST silently discard host loopback addresses conveyed in the Encrypted DNS options.

requirements.title: Discard multicast encrypted DNS addresses
requirements.statement: The host MUST silently discard multicast addresses conveyed in the Encrypted DNS options.

requirements.title: Allow OPTION_V6_DNR in the client ORO
requirements.statement: The OPTION_V6_DNR option MUST be requestable in the client ORO.

requirements.title: Assign DHCPv6 option code 144 to OPTION_V6_DNR
requirements.statement: The DHCPv6 option code for OPTION_V6_DNR MUST be 144.

requirements.title: Do not mark OPTION_V6_DNR as singleton
requirements.statement: The OPTION_V6_DNR option MUST NOT be a singleton option.

requirements.title: Assign DHCPv4 tag 162 to OPTION_V4_DNR
requirements.statement: The DHCPv4 option tag for OPTION_V4_DNR MUST be 162.

requirements.title: Set OPTION_V4_DNR data length to N
requirements.statement: The OPTION_V4_DNR option data length MUST be N.

requirements.title: Assign ND type 144 to the Encrypted DNS option
requirements.statement: The Neighbor Discovery Encrypted DNS option type MUST be 144.

requirements.title: Require secure DNSSEC for ADN-only SVCB resolution
requirements.statement: When ADN-only encrypted DNS discovery relies on SVCB queries as the active-attack mitigation described by RFC 9463, the local policy MUST accept SVCB-derived resolver parameters only when DNSSEC validation reports a secure result.

requirements.title: Plan encrypted DNS session attempts deterministically
requirements.statement: Before opening a network connection, the encrypted DNS client planning layer MUST produce deterministic encrypted DNS session attempts from RFC 9461 SVCB endpoint selection, RFC 9463 discovery plans, and RFC 9464 provisioning plans while preserving protocol, address when supplied, port, authentication name, service priority, service-parameter metadata, HTTPS metadata, and cleartext-fallback eligibility.

requirements.title: Plan host resolver installation without platform mutation
requirements.statement: Before mutating operating-system resolver state, the encrypted DNS client planning layer MUST produce a deterministic host-resolver installation plan from RFC 9461 SVCB endpoint plans, RFC 9463 discovery plans, and RFC 9464 provisioning plans, preserving encrypted session attempts, cleartext fallback resolver candidates, split-tunnel internal domains, installation scope, and policy-blocked states without invoking platform resolver APIs.

requirements.title: Plan router and forwarder advertisements without platform emission
requirements.statement: Before mutating router, DHCP, or Neighbor Discovery state, the encrypted DNS discovery layer MUST produce a deterministic adapter-neutral advertisement plan for router or forwarder publication that selects DHCPv4 OPTION_V4_DNR, DHCPv6 OPTION_V6_DNR, and Neighbor Discovery encrypted DNS payloads from local LAN-facing resolver addresses or ADN-only publication policy while preserving service priority, lifetime, authentication domain name, service-parameter metadata, family-specific applicability, and blocked/no-address statuses without invoking platform advertisement APIs.

requirements.title: ENCDNS_IP* attribute format
requirements.statement: The ENCDNS_IP* Configuration Payload Attribute MUST have the format shown in Figure 1, with the fields in the order shown.

requirements.title: Reserved bit ignored on receipt
requirements.statement: The R bit MUST be ignored on receipt.

requirements.title: Reserved bit set to zero
requirements.statement: The R bit MUST be set to zero.

requirements.title: Length field size
requirements.statement: The Length field MUST be 2 octets.

requirements.title: Length field value
requirements.statement: The Length field MUST be the length of the enclosed data in octets.

requirements.title: Num Addresses zero in request-without-resolver and ACK
requirements.statement: The Num Addresses field MUST be 0 if the Configuration payload has type CFG_REQUEST and no specific DNS resolver is requested, or if it has type CFG_ACK.

requirements.title: Zero Length omits trailing fields
requirements.statement: If the Length field is set to 0, the subsequent fields shown in Figure 1 MUST NOT be present.

requirements.title: ENCDNS_IP4 length formula
requirements.statement: For ENCDNS_IP4 attributes in CFG_REQUEST, CFG_REPLY, or CFG_SET Configuration payloads, the length of the attribute MUST be 4 + Length of the ADN + N * 4 + Length of SvcParams, where N is the number of included IPv4 addresses.

requirements.title: ENCDNS_IP6 length formula
requirements.statement: For ENCDNS_IP6 attributes in CFG_REQUEST, CFG_REPLY, or CFG_SET Configuration payloads, the length of the attribute MUST be 4 + Length of the ADN + N * 16 + Length of SvcParams, where N is the number of included IPv6 addresses.

requirements.title: ADN length interpretation
requirements.statement: The 16-bit unsigned integer MUST be interpreted following the rules specified in Section 2.4.1 of RFC9460.

requirements.title: AliasMode zero prohibited
requirements.statement: This field MUST NOT be set to 0.

requirements.title: Reject zero value for CFG_REPLY and CFG_SET
requirements.statement: If the Configuration payload has type CFG_REPLY or CFG_SET, this value MUST NOT be set to 0.

requirements.title: Define ADN Length as a one-octet field
requirements.statement: The ADN Length field MUST be 1 octet and indicate the length of the Authentication Domain Name field in octets.

requirements.title: ENCDNS_IP4 field carries IPv4 addresses
requirements.statement: For ENCDNS_IP4, this field MUST contain one or more 4-octet IPv4 addresses.

requirements.title: ENCDNS_IP6 field carries IPv6 addresses
requirements.statement: For ENCDNS_IP6, this field MUST contain one or more 16-octet IPv6 addresses.

requirements.title: Authentication Domain Name format
requirements.statement: The Authentication Domain Name MUST be a fully qualified domain name of the encrypted DNS resolver, in DNS presentation format, and use an IDNA A-label.

requirements.title: Reject terminators in the name
requirements.statement: The name MUST NOT contain terminators such as NULL or CR.

requirements.title: Encode SvcParams using RFC9460 wire format
requirements.statement: SvcParams MUST be encoded using the wire format specified in Section 2.2 of RFC9460.

requirements.title: Exclude ipv4hint and ipv6hint SvcParams
requirements.statement: The service parameters MUST NOT include "ipv4hint" or "ipv6hint" SvcParams.

requirements.title: Apply service parameters to all IP addresses
requirements.statement: Service parameters MUST apply to all IP addresses in the ENCDNS_IP* Configuration Payload Attribute.

requirements.title: Encode ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO fields in table order
requirements.statement: The ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO Configuration Payload Attribute MUST contain the R bit, Attribute Type, Length, Num Hash Algs, ADN Length, Authentication Domain Name, List of Hash Algorithm Identifiers, and Certificate Digest fields in the order shown.

requirements.title: Encode ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO CFG_REQUEST fields in table order
requirements.statement: The ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO Configuration Payload Attribute in CFG_REQUEST MUST contain the R bit, Attribute Type, Length, Num Hash Algs, ADN Length, and List of Hash Algorithm Identifiers fields in the order shown.

requirements.title: Ignore the reserved bit on receipt
requirements.statement: Receivers MUST ignore the R bit on receipt.

requirements.title: Set the reserved bit to zero
requirements.statement: Senders MUST set the R bit to zero.

requirements.title: Set Attribute Type to 29
requirements.statement: The Attribute Type field MUST be set to 29.

requirements.title: Define Length as a two-octet unsigned integer
requirements.statement: The Length field MUST be a 2-octet unsigned integer indicating the length of the enclosed data in octets.

requirements.title: Set length from hash-algorithm count
requirements.statement: The Length field MUST be set to 2 + (2 * the number of included hash algorithm identifiers).

requirements.title: Num Hash Algs reflects identifier count
requirements.statement: The Num Hash Algs field MUST indicate the number of identifiers included in the List of Hash Algorithm Identifiers field.

requirements.title: Derive Num Hash Algs from Length
requirements.statement: The Num Hash Algs field MUST be set to (Length - 2) / 2.

requirements.title: Set ADN Length to zero
requirements.statement: The ADN Length field MUST be set to 0.

requirements.title: List supported hash algorithm identifiers
requirements.statement: The List of Hash Algorithm Identifiers field MUST contain 16-bit hash algorithm identifiers supported by the encrypted DNS client.

requirements.title: Limit identifiers to IANA registry values
requirements.statement: The values of the List of Hash Algorithm Identifiers field MUST be identifiers taken from IANA's IKEv2 Hash Algorithms registry.

requirements.title: Omit padding between identifiers
requirements.statement: There MUST be no padding between the hash algorithm identifiers.

requirements.title: Encode attribute layout as specified
requirements.statement: The ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO Configuration Payload Attribute MUST use the field layout shown in the table: R, Attribute Type, Length, Num Hash Algs, ADN Length, Authentication Domain Name, Hash Algorithm Identifier, and Certificate Digest.

requirements.title: Ignore R bit on receipt
requirements.statement: The R bit MUST be ignored on receipt.

requirements.title: Set R bit to zero
requirements.statement: The R bit MUST be set to zero.

requirements.title: Set Attribute Type to 29
requirements.statement: The Attribute Type value MUST be 29.

requirements.title: Set Length to data size
requirements.statement: The Length field MUST be the length of the data in octets.

requirements.title: Set Num Hash Algs to 1
requirements.statement: The Num Hash Algs field MUST be set to 1.

requirements.title: ADN Length indicates Authentication Domain Name length
requirements.statement: The ADN Length field MUST indicate the length of the Authentication Domain Name field in octets.

requirements.title: ADN Length zero applies to conveyed Authentication Domain Name
requirements.statement: If the ADN Length field is set to 0, the digest MUST apply to the Authentication Domain Name conveyed in the ENCDNS_IP* Configuration Payload Attribute.

requirements.title: Authentication Domain Name is a fully qualified domain name
requirements.statement: The Authentication Domain Name MUST be a fully qualified domain name of the encrypted DNS resolver following the syntax defined in RFC 5890.

requirements.title: Prohibit terminators in name
requirements.statement: The name MUST NOT contain any terminators such as NULL or CR.

requirements.title: Name included only with multiple ADNs
requirements.statement: The name MUST be included only when multiple ADNs are included in the ENCDNS_IP* Configuration Payload Attribute.

requirements.title: Hash Algorithm Identifier selects digest algorithm
requirements.statement: The Hash Algorithm Identifier field MUST specify the 16-bit hash algorithm identifier selected by the DNS resolver to generate the digest of its certificate.

requirements.title: Certificate Digest includes SPKI hash
requirements.statement: The Certificate Digest field MUST include the Subject Public Key Info (SPKI) hash of the encrypted DNS resolver certificate using the algorithm identified in the Hash Algorithm Identifier field.

requirements.title: Certificate Digest length formula
requirements.statement: The Certificate Digest field length MUST equal Length - 4 - ADN Length.

requirements.title: ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO allowed in CFG_ACK
requirements.statement: The ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO attribute MAY be present in the Configuration payload of CFG_ACK.

requirements.title: Zero-length ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO data in CFG_ACK
requirements.statement: When the ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO attribute is present in the Configuration payload of CFG_ACK, it MUST be returned with zero-length data.

requirements.title: Handle malformed attributes per RFC7296
requirements.statement: Badly formatted attributes or unacceptable fields MUST be handled as specified in Section 2.21 of [RFC7296].

requirements.title: Advertise encrypted DNS support in CFG_REQUEST
requirements.statement: The initiator MUST indicate support for encrypted DNS by including ENCDNS_IP* attributes in its CFG_REQUEST payloads.

requirements.title: Provide encrypted DNS configuration in CFG_REPLY
requirements.statement: The responder MUST supply encrypted DNS configuration by including ENCDNS_IP* attributes in its CFG_REPLY payloads.

requirements.title: Include ENCDNS_IP4 or ENCDNS_IP6 in CFG_REQUEST
requirements.statement: If the initiator supports encrypted DNS, it MUST include either or both of the ENCDNS_IP4 and ENCDNS_IP6 attributes in its CFG_REQUEST.

requirements.title: Set Length to 0 when not requesting specific resolvers
requirements.statement: If the initiator does not want to request specific DNS resolvers, it MUST set the Length field to 0 for the attribute.

requirements.title: Allow empty attribute or distinct resolver list
requirements.statement: For a given attribute type, the initiator MAY send either an empty attribute or a list of distinct suggested resolvers.

requirements.title: Allow ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO hash algorithm list
requirements.statement: The initiator MAY also include the ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO attribute with a list of hash algorithms supported by the encrypted DNS client.

requirements.title: Require at least one IP address
requirements.statement: The list of IP addresses MUST include at least one IP address.

requirements.title: Allow the responder to ignore suggested values
requirements.statement: The responder MAY ignore suggested values from the initiator, if any.

requirements.title: Return multiple ENCDNS_IP attributes when needed
requirements.statement: Multiple instances of the same ENCDNS_IP* attribute MAY be returned if distinct ADNs or service parameters need to be assigned to the initiator.

requirements.title: Present returned instances by service priority
requirements.statement: These instances MUST be presented to a local DNS client following their service priority, where a smaller service priority value indicates a higher preference.

requirements.title: Optionally return digest info
requirements.statement: The responder MAY return the ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO attribute to convey a digest of the encrypted DNS certificate and the identifier of the hash algorithm used to generate the digest.

requirements.title: Use encrypted DNS resolvers when offered
requirements.statement: If the initiator receives both ENCDNS_IP* and INTERNAL_IP6_DNS (or INTERNAL_IP4_DNS) attributes, it SHOULD use the encrypted DNS resolvers.

requirements.title: Encrypted DNS session uses conveyed address
requirements.statement: The DNS client MUST establish an encrypted DNS session with the address or addresses conveyed in ENCDNS_IP*.

requirements.title: Resolver certificate authentication uses RFC8310 Section 8 mechanisms
requirements.statement: The DNS client MUST use the mechanisms discussed in Section 8 of RFC 8310 to authenticate the DNS resolver certificate using the ADN conveyed in ENCDNS_IP*.

requirements.title: Create an SPKI hash when digest info is present
requirements.statement: If the CFG_REPLY includes an ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO attribute, the client MUST create an SPKI hash of the DNS resolver certificate received in the TLS handshake using the negotiated hash algorithm in the ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO attribute.

requirements.title: Validate the resolver certificate when the digest matches
requirements.statement: If the computed digest for an ADN matches the digest sent in the ENCDNS_DIGEST_INFO attribute, the client MUST consider the encrypted DNS resolver certificate successfully validated.

requirements.title: Treat resolver certificate validation failure as non-recoverable
requirements.statement: If resolver certificate validation fails, the client MUST treat the failure as a non-recoverable error.

requirements.title: Split-tunnel internal DNS resolution
requirements.statement: When the IPsec connection is a split-tunnel configuration and the initiator has negotiated INTERNAL_DNS_DOMAIN as specified in RFC 8598, the DNS client MUST resolve the internal names using the ENCDNS_IP* DNS resolvers.

requirements.title: INTERNAL_DNS_DOMAIN may accompany ENCDNS_IP* without DNS attribute precondition
requirements.statement: If ENCDNS_IP* attributes are supplied, responders MAY include INTERNAL_DNS_DOMAIN even when INTERNAL_IP6_DNS or INTERNAL_IP4_DNS attributes are absent.

requirements.title: Compute SPKI hash from DER-encoded SPKI
requirements.statement: The SPKI hash of the encrypted DNS resolver certificate MUST be the output of a cryptographic hash algorithm over the DER-encoded ASN.1 representation of the SPKI.

requirements.title: Model encrypted DNS Configuration Payload exchange locally
requirements.statement: The encrypted DNS provisioning layer MUST provide a deterministic local Configuration Payload exchange planner that binds CFG_REQUEST support advertisements, CFG_REPLY response selection, and client resolver planning before any live IKEv2 transport or platform resolver integration.

requirements.title: Do not convey IP header fields
requirements.statement: These mechanisms MUST NOT convey fields of the IP header.

requirements.title: Do not tunnel other IP protocols
requirements.statement: These mechanisms MUST NOT tunnel other IP protocols.

requirements.title: Use QUIC variable-length integer encoding
requirements.statement: This specification MUST use the variable-length integer encoding from Section 16 of [QUIC].

requirements.title: Allow non-minimal variable-length integer encodings
requirements.statement: Variable-length integer values MAY be encoded in more than the minimum number of bytes necessary.

requirements.title: Interpret stream as connection without multiplexing
requirements.statement: When the HTTP version in use does not support multiplexing streams (such as HTTP/1.1), any reference to "stream" in this document MUST represent the entire connection.

requirements.title: Require a leading slash in the path component
requirements.statement: The path component of a URI Template MUST start with a slash "/".

requirements.title: Restrict template variables to the path or query components
requirements.statement: All template variables MUST be within the path or query components of the URI.

requirements.title: Allow other URI Template variables
requirements.statement: The URI Template MAY contain other variables.

requirements.title: Allow target and ipproto variables
requirements.statement: The URI Template MAY contain the variables "target" and "ipproto".

requirements.title: Require non-empty target and ipproto values
requirements.statement: If the "target" or "ipproto" variables are included, their values MUST NOT be empty.

requirements.title: Restrict URI Template characters to printable ASCII
requirements.statement: The URI Template MUST contain only ASCII characters in the range 0x21-0x7E inclusive, with percent-encoding allowed.

requirements.title: Forbid dot-prefix label expansion
requirements.statement: The URI Template MUST NOT use Label Expansion with Dot-Prefix.

requirements.title: Forbid fragment expansion
requirements.statement: The URI Template MUST NOT use Fragment Expansion ("#" operator).

requirements.title: Forbid reserved expansion
requirements.statement: The URI Template MUST NOT use Reserved Expansion ("+" operator).

requirements.title: Forbid semicolon-prefix path-style parameter expansion
requirements.statement: The URI Template MUST NOT use Path-Style Parameter Expansion with Semicolon-Prefix.

requirements.title: Forbid slash-prefix path segment expansion
requirements.statement: The URI Template MUST NOT use Path Segment Expansion with Slash-Prefix.

requirements.title: Allow general-purpose URI Template implementations
requirements.statement: Clients MAY use a general-purpose URI Template implementation that lacks this specific validation.

requirements.title: Recommend validating the requirements above
requirements.statement: Clients SHOULD validate the requirements above.

requirements.title: Reject invalid URI Template configurations
requirements.statement: If a client detects that any of the requirements above are not met by a URI Template, the client MUST reject its configuration and abort the request without sending it to the IP proxy.

requirements.title: Allow use of the default template for limited clients
requirements.statement: Clients with such limitations MAY attempt to access IP proxying capabilities using the default template, defined as "https://$PROXY_HOST:$PROXY_PORT/.well-known/masque/ip/{target}/{ipproto}/".

requirements.title: Recommend service at the default template location
requirements.statement: IP proxy deployments SHOULD offer service at this location if they need to interoperate with such clients.

requirements.title: Initiate IP tunnel requests with connect-ip
requirements.statement: A client MUST issue a request containing the `connect-ip` upgrade token to initiate an IP tunnel associated with a single HTTP stream.

requirements.title: Forward requests to the configured HTTP server
requirements.statement: If the recipient is configured to use another HTTP server, it MUST forward the request to that server.

requirements.title: Act as an IP proxy otherwise
requirements.statement: Otherwise, the recipient MUST act as an IP proxy.

requirements.title: Allow rejection of IP proxying requests
requirements.statement: An IP proxy MAY reject the IP proxying request.

requirements.title: Treat invalid tunnel variables as malformed
requirements.statement: If the decoded `target` or `ipproto` variables fail validation, the IP proxy MUST treat the request as malformed.

requirements.title: Tie tunnel lifetime to request stream
requirements.statement: The lifetime of the IP forwarding tunnel MUST be tied to the IP proxying request stream.

requirements.title: Maintain tunnel assignments while the request stream is open
requirements.statement: The IP proxy MUST maintain all IP address and route assignments associated with the IP forwarding tunnel while the request stream is open.

requirements.title: Allow tunnel teardown for inactivity
requirements.statement: IP proxies MAY tear down the tunnel due to inactivity.

requirements.title: Close the request stream when tearing down the tunnel
requirements.statement: If an IP proxy tears down the tunnel due to inactivity, it MUST close the request stream.

requirements.title: Abort the request on a non-successful proxying response
requirements.statement: If the client receives any response other than a successful IP proxying response, the client MUST abort the request.

requirements.title: Use GET method
requirements.statement: The method SHALL be "GET".

requirements.title: Include the Host header field
requirements.statement: The request SHALL include a single Host header field containing the host and optional port of the IP proxy.

requirements.title: Include a Connection header with Upgrade
requirements.statement: The request SHALL include a Connection header field with value "Upgrade"; matching is case-insensitive.

requirements.title: Include the Upgrade header field
requirements.statement: The request SHALL include an Upgrade header field with value "connect-ip".

requirements.title: Respond to malformed requests with an error
requirements.statement: The recipient of such a malformed request MUST respond with an error.

requirements.title: Use 400 for malformed requests
requirements.statement: The recipient of such a malformed request SHOULD use the 400 (Bad Request) status code.

requirements.title: HTTP response status code is 101
requirements.statement: The HTTP status code on the response SHALL be 101 (Switching Protocols).

requirements.title: Connection header value is Upgrade
requirements.statement: The response SHALL include a Connection header field with value "Upgrade"; the value comparison is case-insensitive.

requirements.title: Upgrade header value is connect-ip
requirements.statement: The response SHALL include a single Upgrade header field with value "connect-ip".

requirements.title: Response meets Capsule Protocol start requirements
requirements.statement: The response SHALL meet the requirements of HTTP responses that start the Capsule Protocol; see Section 3.2 of [HTTP-DGRAM].

requirements.title: Failed proxying attempt closes connection
requirements.statement: If any of these requirements are not met, the client MUST treat this proxying attempt as failed and close the connection.

requirements.title: Method pseudo-header is CONNECT
requirements.statement: The :method pseudo-header field SHALL be "CONNECT".

requirements.title: Protocol pseudo-header is connect-ip
